correctness.rationale: Over F2 a perfect evolution algebra has invertible structure M; every algebra isomorphism is monomial, hence a permutation (all nonzero scalars 1). The full automorphism group is exactly its S5 stabilizer under simultaneous row/column permutation. Independent exhaustive C++ enumeration checked all 2^25 binary matrices, their invertibility, every orbit and every permutation stabilizer; it reproduced 9,999,360 labelled invertible matrices, 85,411 orbits and the complete thirteen-type counts (trivial 81408, C2 3694, C3 80, C4 8, V4 113, C5 3, C6 8, S3 73, D8 8, D10 1, S3xC2 7, S4 7, S5 1). Separate fixed-matrix Burnside enumeration reproduced classwise invertible counts 9999360,21504,1536,504,24,32,15, giving 85411. Finite complete certificate, not extrapolation.
residual_risks: Finite n=5/F2 census does not extend to all fields/dimensions; code is exhaustive for fixed finite domain, not formal mechanized proof.
